args: Compare source-backed handoff workflows before implementation
At most eight learner hours; raw results, failure analysis and explicit verdict; no demand claim
Freeze source manifest and ten questions. Compare ordinary workflow and Foundry with equivalent inputs/model access; optional local pinned Hindsight. Record order bias, setup and update cost.
At least 9/10 source-faithful answers, zero unsupported consequential claims, at least 30 percent median recovery-time improvement and positive net recurring savings; pragmatic trial thresholds.
Fidelity failure, adequate incumbent baseline, no recurring pain, overhead erases benefit, or timebox reached inconclusively: adopt/defer/stop; no platform build.
